verdict.rationale: Simular's own features give only glancing support for after-the-fact review. Sai can save a completed run as code that captures the steps taken (simular-docs-7), and operators can watch Sai computers work live with "full transparency" (simular-docs-15). The events API streams progress during a run (simular-docs-10), but nothing documents retaining that stream for later review. Missing for 10: documented post-run history or replay of each step, recorded screenshots or video of the screens seen, logs of keystrokes and inputs injected, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
